segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: I live in a city and there's a metro near my apartment.
segments.zh: 我住在一个城市，我的公寓附近有地铁。

segments.en: I can hear it.
segments.zh: 我能听到。

segments.en: It's very loud.
segments.zh: 声音很大。

segments.en: And so I'm desensitized to the noise.
segments.zh: 所以我对噪音不敏感。

segments.en: That means I don't really notice it anymore.
segments.zh: 这意味着我不再真正注意到它了。

segments.en: It doesn't bother me.
segments.zh: 它不打扰我。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So that's all the vocab and phrases we've prepared for you today.
segments.zh: 这就是我们今天为您准备的所有词汇和短语。

segments.en: Let's listen to this dialogue one last time.
segments.zh: 我们最后再听一遍这段对话。

segments.en: Oh, I feel terrible.
segments.zh: 哦，我感觉很糟糕。

segments.en: I keep sneezing and my eyes are all watery.
segments.zh: 我一直打喷嚏，眼睛不停地流泪。

segments.en: What's wrong with me?
segments.zh: 我这是怎么了？

segments.en: Wow.
segments.zh: 哇。

segments.en: You're not dying, are you?
segments.zh: 你没有死，是吗？

segments.en: It looks like you have a cold.
segments.zh: 看起来你感冒了。

segments.en: You should take some medicine.
segments.zh: 你应该吃点药。

segments.en: I don't think it's a cold.
segments.zh: 我不认为这是感冒。

segments.en: I feel fine if I move a few feet away from my desk.
segments.zh: 如果我离办公桌几英尺远，我感觉很好。

segments.en: Maybe we should put you into quarantine.
segments.zh: 也许我们应该让你隔离。

segments.en: Jokes aside, I think you might have an allergy.
segments.zh: 撇开笑话不谈，我想你可能会过敏。

segments.en: An allergy?
segments.zh: 过敏？

segments.en: I never thought about that.
segments.zh: 我从来没有想过。

segments.en: I don't think I'm allergic to pollen, though, and I'm desensitized to bee stings after being stung so many times.
segments.zh: 不过，我不认为我对花粉过敏，而且在被蜇了很多次后，我对蜜蜂的刺痛不敏感。

segments.en: Hmm.
segments.zh: 嗯。

segments.en: Ow!
segments.zh: 哎哟！

segments.en: Why did you chuck that peanut at me?
segments.zh: 你为什么把花生扔给我？

segments.en: Just checking if you're allergic to peanuts.
segments.zh: 只是检查你是否对花生过敏。

segments.en: I guess not.
segments.zh: 我想不是。

segments.en: Not funny.
segments.zh: 一点也不好笑。

segments.en: I could have gone into anaphylactic shock.
segments.zh: 我可能会发生过敏性休克的！

segments.en: Okay, my bad.
segments.zh: 好吧，我的错。

segments.en: How about dust?
segments.zh: 灰尘呢？

segments.en: This office is full of it.
segments.zh: 这个办公室充满了它。

segments.en: Yes, the whole office is dusty, yet I only feel affected near our desks.
segments.zh: 是的，整个办公室都是尘土飞扬的，但我只觉得在我们的办公桌附近受到影响。

segments.en: You brought your cat into the office?
segments.zh: 你把你的猫带到办公室了？

segments.en: Yeah, it's Mr. Snuffle's birthday today.
segments.zh: 是的，今天是 Snuffle 先生的生日。

segments.en: I didn't want him to be alone on his special day.
segments.zh: 我不希望他在特殊的日子里独自一人。

segments.en: Put it away!
segments.zh: 收起来！

segments.en: I guess we found the problem.
segments.zh: 我想我们发现了问题。

segments.en: You're allergic to cats.
segments.zh: 你对猫过敏。

segments.en: Alright, so speaking about allergies, we always talk about the common ones like pollen, dust, and you also mentioned about food, like somebody who cannot drink milk.
segments.zh: 好吧，说到过敏，我们总是谈论花粉、灰尘等常见的，你也提到了食物，比如一个不能喝牛奶的人。

segments.en: They're allergic to milk.
segments.zh: 他们对牛奶过敏。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: We have a special name for this, actually.
segments.zh: 实际上，我们有一个特殊的名称。

segments.en: Someone who cannot drink milk or dairy products like ice cream is called lactose intolerant.
segments.zh: 不能喝牛奶或冰淇淋等乳制品的人称为乳糖不耐症。

segments.en: So if you're lactose intolerant, it means that your stomach is very upset after you have dairy products because lactose is basically dairy.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您有乳糖不耐症，这意味着您在拥有乳制品后胃部非常不适，因为乳糖基本上是乳制品。

segments.en: And there are some people also who are allergic to seafood, for example, fish or shrimp or any type of seafood.
segments.zh: 还有一些人对海鲜过敏，例如鱼或虾或任何类型的海鲜。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And also people who are allergic to gluten.
segments.zh: 还有对麸质过敏的人。

segments.en: Now, gluten is a very common product that is found in breads and cereal, things like that.
segments.zh: 现在，麸质是一种非常常见的产品，存在于面包和谷类食品中，诸如此类。

segments.en: And so people who have an allergy to gluten actually have to change their diet quite a bit.
segments.zh: 因此，对麸质过敏的人实际上必须改变他们的饮食。

segments.en: Yeah, they have to look for things that are gluten-free, which is very hard because apparently it's in everything.
segments.zh: 是的，他们必须寻找无麸质的东西，这非常困难，因为显然它无处不在。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So if you have one of these allergies, you can find dairy-free on a box or gluten-free on the box.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您有这些过敏症之一，您可以在盒子上找到无乳制品或在盒子上不含麸质。

segments.en: And specialty food stores will have these labels.
segments.zh: 特色食品商店将有这些标签。

segments.en: And so are you allergic to anything?
segments.zh: 那么你对任何东西过敏吗？

segments.en: No, not really.
segments.zh: 不，也不完全是。

segments.en: Sometimes here in China, I feel like I'm a little bit allergic.
segments.zh: 有时在中国，我觉得我有点过敏。

segments.en: I have allergies when the seasons change.
segments.zh: 当季节变化时，我有过敏症。

segments.en: But at home, no.
segments.zh: 但在家里，没有。

segments.en: I have no allergies.
segments.zh: 我没有过敏。

segments.en: No allergies.
segments.zh: 没有过敏。

segments.en: No, me neither.
segments.zh: 对，我也这么想。

segments.en: And I'm very lucky, I think, because I can't imagine if I had an allergy like to peanuts or to seafood, which not only would be a shame because you can't have these foods, but if you accidentally have it, it could be life-threatening.
segments.zh: 我很幸运，因为我无法想象如果我对花生或海鲜过敏，这不仅会因为你不能吃这些食物而感到羞耻，而且如果你不小心吃了它，可能会危及生命。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Like my dad, who is allergic to bees, would go into anaphylactic shock if he were stung.
segments.zh: 就像我爸爸对蜜蜂过敏一样，如果他被刺伤，他会陷入过敏性休克。

segments.en: And so you have to be very careful because you never know when you'll have an accident like that.
segments.zh: 所以你必须非常小心，因为你永远不知道什么时候会发生这样的事故。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So this is an interesting topic.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个有趣的话题。

segments.en: Maybe you guys want to share if you are allergic to anything.
segments.zh: 如果你对任何事情过敏，也许你们想分享。

segments.en: Maybe you are allergic to certain types of foods, chemicals.
segments.zh: 也许您对某些类型的食品、化学品过敏。

segments.en: Some people are allergic to certain types of shampoo, for example.
segments.zh: 例如，有些人对某些类型的洗发水过敏。

segments.en: Or fabrics like cotton.
segments.zh: 或者像棉花这样的面料。

segments.en: So if you want to share with us, let us know at our website EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您想与我们分享，请在我们的网站 englishpod.com 上告诉我们。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.en: Bye!
segments.zh: 再见！
